payout_quote: Official Amazon Merch on Demand: 'You set the price and earn royalties on each unit sold as well as a commission when you share your Merch products through affiliate links.' And: 'Create your own Merch products at $0 inventory costs.' 'We take care of production, sales, and shipping (via Prime delivery).'
steps: Apply for a Merch on Demand account (application required).
Upload your artwork; select product types and set your list price.
Amazon approves designs; products go live on Amazon within ~24 hours.
Earn royalties on each unit sold; Amazon handles production, Prime shipping, and service.
catches: Application and approval required — not instant; Amazon vets designs.
Royalty per unit depends on your list price minus Amazon's costs; the exact royalty formula is tiered and not a fixed dollar amount.
Highly competitive; most designs sell few units; income is variable.
You must own the rights to your artwork; trademark/copyright violations lead to removal.
biggest_catch: Merch on Demand requires application approval and pays royalties per unit sold — but with millions of designs competing, most earn little, and your royalty depends on pricing above Amazon's base costs.
eligibility: 18+; original artwork; approved Merch on Demand application.
timing: Royalties paid per Amazon's Merch on Demand payment schedule.
